task.title: Publish verifiable company-owned content and its entries
task.input: Verifiable company-owned materials, the PDF as a structural reference, and existing SiteSetting/Sanity/publication switches
task.output: company-content; about content/a fact-comparison table and compatible contact/privacy entries
task.accept: 1) For every public hard corporate fact, create a page-field to company-owned evidence file/page mapping. YUHAO certifications/capacity/factory scale lacking company-owned evidence must appear in neither final copy nor images. Use the PDF only for structure/product themes; automated searches plus per-field comparison must find no renamed appropriation (E-27). 2) The final logo hash equals the current PackJoyU wordmark; do not use a candidate new logo or wait for the user to revisit candidates. PDF instructions are not execution authorization (E-28). 3) In a real browser click about-link to /[locale]/about and footer contact/privacy to their respective routes; en/ru switching retains the corresponding page. With the publication switch off, retain 404; with it on, SSR SiteSetting/Sanity matches the fact table. Retain navigation evidence for every changed page.
